dcache_lane_observation.experiment: Cold load at word offset one, then halfword and byte stores with an immediate readback after each store. Repeat on a cold store to verify the allocated cache line. Check external refill addresses, store byte address, mask and data, plus cached data.

execution_observation.expected: four read beats, x2=41, exit=10, five ordered retirements and a D-wait bypass event
